title: The Marketing Environment Explained Simply | Marketing Management Ep 5
description:
One month, jaggery gets costlier, a new bakery opens near the college, and everyone starts talking about millets. None of it happened in Nani's kitchen, but all of it changes Laddoo Lab. In this animated lesson, a tiny millet laddoo brand from a home kitchen in Bengaluru shows what the marketing environment is and how smart marketers deal with it.

You will see Kotler and Armstrong's definition, the actors and forces outside marketing that affect a company's ability to build relationships with customers, and the difference between actors (suppliers, rivals, customers) and forces (prices, laws, technology, trends). We split what Zoya can control inside Laddoo Lab from what she can only watch outside, then run a live radar scan: spot the change, judge it as a threat or an opportunity, and respond, for a jaggery price rise, a cheap new rival, and the United Nations' International Year of Millets in 2023. We see the same moves at work today in an airline, a bank, a bakery and a cafe, and look honestly at the human side: scanning takes time, some signals are false alarms, and some shocks, like India's nationwide lockdown in March 2020, no radar can see.

This is Episode 5 of our Marketing Management series for MBA, BBA and commerce students.
